yeah.translationZh: 是啊，教室里可能会有一股油漆味，让学校里的空气变得特别沉闷。
yeah.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

yeah.sentenceEn: M: Yeah , I thought so too.

yield.sentenceEn: Unfortunately, the crisis of global warming has already had a serious negative impact on cacao farms' yields , leading to the prices of chocolates skyrocketing.
yield.translationZh: 不幸的是，全球变暖危机已对可可农场的产量造成严重负面影响，导致巧克力价格飙升。
yield.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

yield.sentenceEn: Other studies, including studies of wheat in India and corn in Africa, also found that there is a threshold above which yields sharply decline: crops can adapt and move, but only to a point.
yield.translationZh: 其他研究，包括对印度小麦和非洲玉米的研究，也发现存在一个临界点，超过这个温度，产量就会急剧下降：作物可以适应环境并迁移，但这种适应和迁移是有限度的。

yield.sentenceEn: But eventually, yields will likely suffer because the soil north of Iowa declines in quality—a legacy of glacial(冰川的) expansion.
yield.translationZh: 但最终，产量可能还是会下降，因为艾奥瓦州北部的土壤质量在退化——这是冰川扩张留下的后遗症。

yield.sentenceEn: Overall, the yields of many foods, from staples to life-enhancing extras such as coffee and chocolate, will likely be impacted by climate change too.
yield.translationZh: 总体而言，许多食物的产量，从主食到咖啡、巧克力等改善生活品质的非必需品，都可能受到气候变化的影响。

yield.sentenceEn: Although farms in the US can move a bit northward, crop yields may decrease.
yield.translationZh: 尽管美国的农场可以向北方迁移一定距离，但农作物产量可能会下降。

yield.sentenceEn: Their food yields have begun to decrease sharply in recent years.
yield.translationZh: 他们的粮食产量近年来已开始急剧下降。

yoga.sentenceEn: W: Well, I guess I am only really interested in hot yoga .
yoga.translationZh: 女士：嗯，我想我真正感兴趣的只有热瑜伽。
yoga.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

yoga.sentenceEn: Currently we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes, hot yoga , and advanced spinning, but the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes I'm afraid.
yoga.translationZh: 目前我们为现有会员提供两种全新课程的折扣优惠：热瑜伽和高级动感单车，但遗憾的是折扣不适用于任何常规课程。
yoga.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

yoga.sentenceEn: He knew my love for yoga and had seen a space close to where he lived that he thought might be good to serve as a yoga studio.
yoga.translationZh: 他知道我热爱瑜伽，并且在他住处附近看到一处地方，他觉得很适合用作瑜伽馆。

yoga.sentenceEn: Only a few months later Leah opened her first yoga studio, but success was not instant.
yoga.translationZh: 仅仅几个月后，莉亚就开了她的第一家瑜伽馆，但成功并非一蹴而就。

yoga.sentenceEn: Leah's interest in yoga prompted her to make a firm decision to reshape her life.
yoga.translationZh: 利亚对瑜伽的兴趣促使她下定决心重塑自己的人生。

yoga.sentenceEn: She wasn't so much interested in hot yoga .
yoga.translationZh: 她对热瑜伽并不是那么感兴趣。

youth.sentenceEn: Catherine Ritman Smith, head of learning at the Design Museum, is expecting around 10,000 participants aged 13 to 16 to take part this year and says that the project—funded by Deutsche Bank as part of its youth engagement programme Born To Be—is the biggest event in the museum's calendar.
youth.translationZh: 设计博物馆学习部主管凯瑟琳·里特曼·史密斯预计，今年将有约1万名13至16岁的参与者参加。她表示，该项目由德意志银行资助，是其青年参与计划"天生不凡"(Born To Be)的一部分，也是博物馆日程表上规模最大的活动。

youth.sentenceEn: One of the most famous examples of this is the story of 92-year-old Henry Dryer, who comes out of dementia(痴呆) while listening to songs from his youth .
youth.translationZh: 最著名的例子之一是 92 岁的亨利·德赖尔的故事，他在听年轻时代的歌曲时，从失智状态中清醒了过来。
youth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

youth.sentenceEn: In another study, older adults, with an average age of 75, performed better than participants in their youth or middle years on tasks that required them to determine the meaning of words.
youth.translationZh: 另一项研究显示，平均年龄为75岁的老年人在需要确定词语含义的任务上表现优于青年或中年参与者。
youth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

youth.sentenceEn: I've come to the brutal realisation that Australia's youth are being done a great disservice by not receiving any consistent financial education.
youth.translationZh: 我痛苦地意识到，澳大利亚的年轻人没有接受任何系统的金融教育，这对他们是极大的伤害。
youth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

youth.sentenceEn: High-tech industries such as NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory have found that their best overall problem solvers were master tinkerers in their youth .
youth.translationZh: 像美国国家航空航天局喷气推进实验室这样的高科技企业发现，他们最优秀的全能问题解决者在年轻时都是摆弄小玩意的高手。
youth.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

youth.sentenceEn: It is unrealistic to give all Australian youth a financial education.
youth.translationZh: 为所有澳大利亚年轻人提供金融教育是不现实的。
